summary_en: The study tests MGC030, an antibody-drug conjugate, in people with advanced solid tumors, including urothelial, colorectal, gastric or gastroesophageal, esophageal, and pancreatic cancer. Study treatment is given initially every 3 weeks, and the route of administration is not stated. The study measures side effects and whether the cancer shrinks, stays stable, or stops progressing, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa MGC030, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos cáncer urotelial, colorrectal, gástrico o de la unión gastroesofágica, esofágico y pancreático. El tratamiento del estudio se administra inicialmente cada 3 semanas, y la vía de administración no está indicada. El estudio mide los efectos secundarios y si el cáncer se reduce, se mantiene estable o deja de progresar, y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic urothelial, colorectal, gastric/GEJ, esophageal, or pancreatic cancer.
Cancer that is refractory to standard therapy, or for which standard therapy does not exist, is intolerable, or was refused (dose escalation).
Expansion groups require progression after specified prior systemic therapy lines for each cancer type.
At least one lesion measurable by RECIST v1.1.
Available archival or FFPE tumor tissue, or willingness to undergo a biopsy.
not_for: Active brain metastases or leptomeningeal metastases.
Prior stem cell, tissue, or solid organ transplant.
Another malignancy that required treatment within the past 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Prior treatment with topoisomerase 1-based ADCs for cancer.
Active viral, bacterial, or fungal infection.
